__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the existing Flux-enabled InfluxDB datasource

title: TREVCAN CAN Explorer (combined draft)
description: Read-only raw frame list and decoded signals from the reliable telemetry pipeline.

panels.title: CAN messages: raw + decoded — latest 500
panels.description: One row per frame. Raw CAN ID and bytes stay visible; recognized frames also show the DBC message and decoded signals in the same row.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_frame")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seq" or r._field == "data" or r._field == "dlc" or r._field == "message" or r._field == "dbc" or r._field == "decoded")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "car", "can_id", "ext"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "car", "seq", "can_id", "ext", "data", "dlc", "message", "decoded", "dbc"])

panels.title: Captured frames per second
panels.description: Count of raw CAN frames exported to InfluxDB per second.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_frame" and r._field == "seq")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Inverter temperatures
panels.description: Works with the current temperature simulator; exact names depend on the chosen DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^INV_.*(Temp|Temperature)/)
